The structure of Cs6Rb2 (reduced formula Cs3Rb) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Cs and Rb centers adopt a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with eight geometric neighbors of the opposite element at 4.2667 Å; Cs has four Cs and four Rb neighbors, while Rb has eight Cs neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between like 8-vertex Cs and Rb coordination polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Cs and Rb polyhedra.
